title: Two-way scan of a word
statement: Let $\delta:A\times\mathrm{Option}(\Gamma)\to A$, let $a\in A$, and let $w$ be a word over $\Gamma$. Suppose a two-work-tape configuration $d$ has forward scan state $a$, and tape 0, at each offset $p$ from $-1$ through $|w|$ relative to its head, contains the corresponding symbol of $w$ when $0\le p<|w|$ and is blank otherwise. After $2|w|+2$ steps of the scanning machine, its state is the completed state whose accumulator is the result of folding $\delta$ over $w$ from $a$, with all other configuration data unchanged; at every earlier time its state is not a completed state. At every time up to and including $2|w|+2$, the head of tape 0 lies between its initial position minus one and its initial position plus $|w|$, inclusive, and every other work-tape head remains at its initial position.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is a two-work-tape configuration on input $x$
Tape 0 matches the word encoding at every offset from $-1$ through $|w|$
